newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends routine day firmer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends routine day firmer.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar ended a rangebound day firmer.
Active May last traded at its day's high of $308.00, up 60 cents.
A dull New York performance had failed to inspire London, after unexpected volatility on Monday, traders said.
May dominated volume with 748 lots traded of a total 1,206. Volume was boosted by crosses and against actuals trades.
Mixed trade and broker buying supported nearbys at the lows, traders said.
